authority_boundary.assignment_meaning: Each formal case receives at least one pre-approval synthetic or pseudonymous profile ID for planning.

formal_case_binding.ordered_id_sha256_contract: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON array in canonical source order with trailing LF

assignment_rule.ordering: canonical test case source order; BASE first; additional profile IDs sorted lexicographically
assignment_rule.base_rule: Assign TDP-SYNTH-BASE-001 to every one of the exact 279 formal test IDs.
assignment_rule.additional_rule: Assign only the explicit NPC/Gate additions in forced_exact_assignments; do not infer mappings from automated suite or fixture names.
assignment_rule.seed_derivation_contract: SHA-256(test_run_id + LF + test_case_id + LF + profile_id + LF + source_binding_sha256); no seed or instance is generated by this overlay.

profile_definitions.title: 전 정식 시험 공통 합성 실행 문맥
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Derive non-secret deterministic values from the approved run ID, test case ID, profile ID and source binding hash.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: No production input is accepted; generated identifiers have no reversible link to a person, device or organization.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: Only secret_ref identifiers may be recorded; no secret value, credential, token or TMAP key may be generated or stored.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: Delete generated resources by run end plus 24 hours; retain only redacted receipt hashes under an approved evidence policy.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Purge the run namespace and record cleanup scope, time, result and receipt hash.

profile_definitions.title: 합성 용량·실패·재시도·복구 문맥
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Generate bounded payload sizes and deterministic failure schedules inside an isolated test namespace.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: Payload contents are generated bytes and synthetic metadata only.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: Infrastructure credentials and billing identifiers are prohibited; approved test secret_ref only.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: Purge load payloads, queues and temporary storage at cleanup.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Verify queue, database and object-store namespace counts are zero and record receipts.

profile_definitions.title: 합성 Gateway·Backend·관리자 상관관계 문맥
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Create all resources under one test-run namespace and propagate the same synthetic correlation ID across app, Gateway, Backend and Admin boundaries.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: No real reporter, institution, administrator or service account is accepted.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: Gateway, Backend and Admin credentials are injected only from an approved test secret_ref and never recorded.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: Drop the namespaced DB schema, object prefix, queue prefix and Admin session by run end plus 24 hours.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Purge all cross-service resources, verify the namespace is empty, and bind cleanup receipts.

profile_definitions.title: 합성 가명 계정·동의·권한 문맥
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Generate namespaced actor and consent identifiers; reference test-secret injection by secret_ref only.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: Never import a real account, phone number, email, administrator identity or reversible mapping.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: Authentication material remains outside fixtures and evidence; record only redacted fingerprints and secret_ref.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: Revoke test actors and consent records at cleanup; deadline run end plus 24 hours.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Revoke actors, purge sessions and consent rows, then issue a namespaced cleanup receipt.

profile_definitions.title: 합성 보존·삭제·철회 생명주기 문맥
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Create a namespaced synthetic lifecycle graph with fixed timestamps and no production source.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: Synthetic subject IDs cannot be resolved to real people; no mapping table is created.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: Deletion authorization material is secret_ref only.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: All generated primary/copy/backup instances expire no later than run end plus 24 hours.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Delete every lifecycle node and retain only redacted deletion receipt hashes.

profile_definitions.title: 생성 미디어·모델·원본수집 통제 대체물
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Use generated media or separately licensed deidentified fixtures; strip identifying metadata before use.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: Faces, plates, voice identifiers, real location metadata and real raw collection are prohibited.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: Model registry credentials and object-store credentials are secret_ref only.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: Delete generated media by run end plus 24 hours and keep only hashes and cleanup receipts.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Delete namespaced blobs and local copies, verify absence, and record a receipt hash.
profile_definitions.boundary: Synthetic media cannot close the raw-original collection NPC or release-review Gate.

profile_definitions.title: 합성 release gate·검토·훈련 문맥
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Generate non-authoritative candidate and review identifiers for workflow rehearsal only.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: No real approver identity or production release artifact is imported.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: Signing keys, deployment credentials and production tokens are prohibited.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: Discard rehearsal resources at cleanup; retain only redacted planning receipts.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Remove rehearsal namespaces and mark all synthetic approvals non-authoritative.

profile_definitions.title: 합성 위치·경로·방향 문맥
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Generate coordinates in a documented non-real grid; external service behavior is represented by a controlled synthetic response.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: No exact real location, home/work address, travel history or device location is accepted.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: No TMAP key is generated or stored; any later sandbox call must use an approved secret_ref.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: Delete generated routes and cached responses at cleanup.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Purge route cache and request logs in the run namespace and record a receipt.

profile_definitions.title: 합성 보행·기기·센서·네트워크 상태
profile_definitions.generation_rule: Generate bounded state-machine sequences from the deterministic run seed.
profile_definitions.deidentification_rule: Do not read a real device serial, sensor history, network identifier or personal movement trace.
profile_definitions.secret_rule: No network credential or device unlock material is allowed.
profile_definitions.retention_rule: Discard generated sequences and queues at cleanup; retain only aggregate redacted evidence.
profile_definitions.disposal_rule: Clear app test state and namespaced queues and record the cleanup result.

global_generation_and_deidentification_c.namespace_contract: All app, Gateway, Backend, Admin, database, bucket and queue resources must share one approved test-run namespace.
global_generation_and_deidentification_c.pseudonym_rule: Pseudonymous IDs are generated for the run and have no real-person lookup table.
global_generation_and_deidentification_c.location_rule: Use a documented non-real coordinate grid; exact real locations are prohibited.
global_generation_and_deidentification_c.media_rule: Use generated or separately licensed deidentified fixtures; synthetic media cannot satisfy raw-original collection release review.
global_generation_and_deidentification_c.admin_gateway_rule: Use synthetic actor/correlation IDs and isolated test resources; production endpoint, shared administrator account and production storage are prohibited.
global_generation_and_deidentification_c.secret_rule: Only approved test secret_ref identifiers and redacted fingerprints may appear; secret values, credentials, signing keys and TMAP keys are prohibited.

retention_and_disposal_controls.cleanup_pending_effect: No case may be finalized as formal PASS while cleanup is pending or failed.
retention_and_disposal_controls.retained_content: Only approved redacted evidence metadata and cleanup receipt hashes; no raw fixture, credential or reversible pseudonym map.

triggers: actual personal identifier or reversible pseudonym map appears in fixture, repository, log, screenshot or evidence
credential, secret value, signing key or TMAP key appears outside the approved secret store
real face, plate, voice identifier or exact location metadata appears in unapproved media
production endpoint, production database, production bucket, production queue or shared Admin account is contacted
cleanup cannot prove namespaced resources were removed
data_leak_stop_criteria.formal_result_effect: The affected run contributes zero formal PASS results until reviewed, remediated and rerun.

raw_collection_boundary.future_actual_raw_rule: If separately approved later, store only controlled-repository reference ID, hash, consent/approval references, access controls, retention and disposal receipts in Git-tracked evidence.

allowed: This add-only overlay deterministically assigns at least one pre-approval synthetic or pseudonymous profile ID to each exact formal test ID.
Profile definitions specify generation, deidentification, secret prohibition, retention, disposal, leak-stop and Admin/Gateway boundaries.
No canonical test case or original test_data_ids field is modified.
prohibited: A profile instance, personal dataset, credential or TMAP key was generated.
Any profile is approved or provisioned for formal execution.
An automated fixture is mapped to a formal test without an explicit reviewed edge.
Any of the 279 formal tests ran or passed.
Synthetic media closes the raw collection release-review gate.

source_bindings.prohibited_claim: Formal execution, PASS, fixture linkage or data-instance provisioning.

source_bindings.prohibited_claim: Formal data provisioning, production access, migration, restore or release completion.

source_bindings.prohibited_claim: Named git commit, deployment or formal verification.

source_bindings.allowed_claim: Bound internal inventory/build evidence and the exact formal test ID set hash.
source_bindings.prohibited_claim: Formal test execution, device PASS or release eligibility.

source_bindings.allowed_claim: Source-bound internal JVM, Gateway and isolated Backend/PostGIS results.
source_bindings.prohibited_claim: Formal 279 PASS, actual-device E2E, TMAP, production or release completion.

source_bindings.allowed_claim: Exact current formal ID/order/source/lineage/module-projection boundary used by this data overlay.
source_bindings.prohibited_claim: Formal execution, PASS, fixture mapping or release completion.

upstream_test_trace_binding.prohibited_claim: Formal execution, PASS, fixture mapping or release completion.
